name: render-remotion-hyperframes-cloudflare
description: A working guide to rendering Remotion and HyperFrames video code on Cloudflare Containers.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix examples/remotion-only install && npm --prefix examples/hyperframes-only install && npm --prefix examples/mixed install

RENDER_SECRET.description: The key every API request must send as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. At least 16 characters; make one with `openssl rand -hex 24` and keep it in a password manager. Anyone who has it can start renders on your account.

RENDER_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for chunks, finished videos and uploaded input files. Downloads from R2 have no egress fee.

MAX_INSTANCES_PER_RENDER.description: The most container instances (`standard-4`) one render may use: **your spend limit per render**. The `fast` tier asks for 4.

INSTANCE_TYPE.description: Container size. Keep `standard-4` (4 vCPU, 12 GiB) for rendering.

INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: An idle instance stops after this many seconds. It bills memory and disk until then.

ENABLE_INTERNET.description: `true` lets the containers fetch web fonts, remote media and uploaded files.

SERVICE_NAME.description: Shown by `/health` and in every logged event.
